stem.text: A skateboarder and her skateboard have a total mass of $70\,\text{kg}$. She pushes on the ground with her foot to create a forward force $F$ of $25\,\text{N}$ on herself and the skateboard, as shown in the diagram.

stem.alt: Diagram of a skateboarder on a skateboard on a horizontal surface, with the label total mass of skateboarder and skateboard 70 kg, and a horizontal arrow labelled F = 25 N pointing forwards.

stem.text: The skateboarder and skateboard travel forwards a distance of $0.50\,\text{m}$ before the skateboarder lifts her foot from the ground.
What is the work done by $F$ on the skateboarder and skateboard?
